verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents a Management API for programmatic control, such as listing runs filtered by status. Triggering a task returns a handle that can check status, cancel and retry the run, and per-environment API keys can be scoped, restricted to specific tasks and given expiry dates. A Realtime API streams run updates. However, the documented surface is delivered through the `@trigger.dev/sdk` TypeScript module, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec at any of the candidate paths. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/REST spec, documented raw HTTP endpoints independent of the TypeScript SDK, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.
